focus: Angle 1 [logic] — streaming-reply single-identity state machine: UUID minted at start, typed forming-state reset, ephemeral-before-durable finalization, segment identity preservation, and clear-versus-finalize orphan handling.

graphEvents.label: UUID minted before first token and reused for durable row
Ephemeral stream ends before durable mutation

OGAM chat store and finalization sources

label: Mint the reply UUID before the first token and reuse it for stream frames, persistence, and peer deduplication.
Every forming-reply lifecycle transition spreads one typed NO_REPLY_FORMING value so new streaming fields cannot be forgotten.
Retire the ephemeral stream before emitting the durable upsert; the durable row replaces the preview by the same identity.
Finalize any shown partial, including reasoning-only output; clear only when no streaming conversation exists.
Streaming fields are excluded from persisted state; finalized messages carry UUIDs.
Segment reset clears text buffers but preserves conversation, UUID, and active streaming state.

direction: Mint durable identity only at finalization
reason: A peer cannot match the live preview to the later record without heuristics, risking duplicate rendering.
